whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Cakery Nook,

I noticed your bakery has stellar 4.8★ reviews in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for custom cake orders and party inquiries.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, custom flavor showcase, aur anniversary/birthday menu integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cakerynook

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Cakery Nook, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and a showcase of your top-rated Mithapur specialty cakes. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
